summary: The test suite contains a use-after-free bug in the cleanup of a global CURL handle due to missing NULL assignment after curl_easy_cleanup.

claims.text: curl_easy_cleanup(t1555_curl) is called without checking if t1555_curl is NULL or valid, leading to use-after-free or double-free
claims.reasoning: The report describes a test file lib1555.c with function test_lib1555, global t1555_curl, and test_cleanup label. Deterministic checks confirm these symbols are ungrounded — they do not exist in curl at the checked revision (master 68a44edd500a on 2025-12-05) or in any release since 7.50. The quoted code from the report does not appear in the curl codebase.
